scope: Private DE-W034 same-executable Windows ordinary-file image verification worker. No product image.verify command, stable public ABI, production journal, physical admission or authenticated custody.
definition: Bind the exact acquisition operation, case revision, raw request and current case-source files; a reconstructed typed verification definition and actual image/map bindings; the verifier source/input/configuration/binary identities and target; host identity; exact ordinary execution-store generations and fixed children. Preparation opens only explicitly selected ordinary inputs and creates nothing. Never follow source/destination/map paths from the retained acquisition request.
grant: Before following supplied resource paths, require the exact wrapper digest and all case_read, image_read, map_read, store_write, host_effects and private_metadata flags. Owned metadata and collection retention are explicit effects, never a claim that verification makes no host writes. Inner-only/wrong digests and any false flag refuse without output. No overwrite/retry/removal of a claimed or unresolved store.
execution: Self-spawn without a shell or standard handles, with an explicit five-handle capability list and existing same-user/session aggregate process/memory budgets plus a one-process 128 MiB private job. Child checks handle types, fixed paths, file IDs, initial sizes, persisted request, jobs and exact fresh inputs before verification. Admission waits at most 3000 ms. Timeout preserves operation identity and dependencies; it never means exit or authorizes replacement. This bounds the admission wait, not every synchronous filesystem call or the public caller.
records: Canonical finite hash-chained progress records bind definition, operation, attempt, worker and capture epochs, host, verifier code and actual PID/creation time. Separate phase, progress, terminal verification verdict, cancellation observation, collection retention certainty and provider quiescence. Progress is sampled only after confirmed checkpoints, at most twelve times. Cancellation requests persist independently; late requests cannot rewrite a completed verdict. Provider handles close before quiescent terminal evidence; inspectors observe OS process identity separately.
retention: Keep the actual terminal typed outcome independently of retention success. Persist a complete typed ImageVerificationCollection under the fixed owned collection filename, binding actual observer epochs/PID/creation time. Flush/readback and full pure restore precede verified retention. Partial writes, torn terminal records, worker exits and uncertain effects remain unresolved and retained. Inspection of a historical completed collection opens only the explicitly selected store, never paths recorded in its bytes. Compatible reads do not require current writer code authority.
watch: Private finite history reads expose validated records and a digest cursor in the operation/attempt/worker/capture domain. Reject conflicting cursors before advancing; retain the last complete record on torn suffixes. Public negotiated event/frontends and bounded caller request containment remain a later gate.
qualification: Independently verify raw chains, digests, progress counters, actual launch/process identity and collection bytes. Test normal/mismatched images, cancellation before and during reads, late cancellation, delayed admission, repeat-start observation, missing grants, stale resources/code, reserved aliases, malformed/torn records, retention and terminal-store failures. Preserve worker dependencies until actual owned-process exit. Product command count and native verification adapter exclusion remain unchanged.
